title: Right-Click Event-Delivery Correction (manual-acceptance failure fix)
corrects: EVI-MA-06 (NOT accepted: physical right-click did not open the context menu)
first_failed_stage: EVENT_RECEIVED never fired — no contextmenu listener existed
root_cause: the right-click bridge lived inside MrtDirectManipulationTool (installed onPostInstall/onDataButtonDown, removed onCleanup). Bentley ToolAdmin activates the view-navigation tool after camera orbit/pan / focus change / when the primitive tool was never armed, running the primitive tool's onCleanup which detached the only contextmenu listener. After any camera move (or before any left-click) there was no listener, so right-click was a no-op. Picking math was never reached.

fix.new_module: appObjectContextMenuBridge.ts (tool-independent, capture-phase, bound to the viewport host for the viewport lifetime)
fix.install_hook: overlay setActiveProductViewport(vp) — same hook the viewer uses to register/deregister its live ScreenViewport; idempotent per host element; re-installs on viewport remount
fix.tool_owned_bridge: installEquipmentContextMenuBridge neutralized to a no-op so there is exactly ONE capture-phase listener (no double-handling / stopPropagation race); onResetButtonUp kept as a tool-native secondary path

proves: real contextmenu event opens the menu store with the exact CYCLOTRON id
empty/native-BIM closes app menus and does NOT preventDefault (browser menu preserved)
listener persists across repeated events (simulated tool switches); dispose removes it
structured diagnostics record first reached stage
NO_RAY diagnostic when the viewport cannot build a ray

honesty_note: Proven at the DOM-event level (a real contextmenu event opens the menu store with the correct id) and by the tool-independent viewport-lifetime binding that addresses the diagnosed failure. Final visible-menu confirmation in the live Bentley browser is the manual-acceptance step.
